flags: The cache documents construction of the Lassen park road, but not who campaigned for the entire interstate byway or its designation chronology. History therefore concerns this explicitly identified component road.

Retained south-to-north moment order. Material strip mileage combines loops and an alternate and is not a simple linear route: Malone is on Oregon 39 while the main route uses U.S. 97. Medicine Lake/Lava Beds is an alternate, not a required mainline stop.
Crater Lake depths conflict: partnership gives 1,943 feet, Wikipedia gives 1,949 feet, and ODOT describes historical soundings of 1,996 and 1,932 feet. No current depth or world ranking is asserted.
Cached ODOT seasonal access advice is not a live opening guarantee. The checked dates indicate cache review only; no exact 2026 opening or closing day is supplied.

23.txt reports Cleetwood Cove Trail/marina closure and suspended lake access and boat tours through summer 2028, contradicting generic tour invitations in other pages. No boat-tour, swimming or island-access recommendation is made; no park-manager closure page is cached.

The park-preservation motive and historic Dutton apparatus in current are supported. Dropped the approximate 100-million-gallons wording because 30.txt states the amount without approximation; flow volume is unnecessary to this account.

Scientific detail is limited to the cached summaries; the underlying USGS sources are referenced there but not independently cached. No eruption forecast or contested largest-volcano superlative is repeated.
